summary: On the fire escape, Trinity looks down into the alley and sees Agent Smith staring up at her. With him blocking the way down, her only option is to go up.

what_changes.before: She has the fire escape as a potential route down toward the alley.
what_changes.after: With Agent Smith below, the alley is blocked and her only escape is upward.
what_changes.evidence: In the alley below, Trinity sees Agent Smith staring at her.  She can only go up.

event_hint.one_line: Trinity, fleeing an Agent, finds her way down blocked and is forced upward.
